_comment: Two grades, per DESIGN-RELICS. A COMMON relic is a stat bundle: it carries a 'stats' block, never a 'hook', and resolves entirely in StatMath.ApplyRelic before the simulation starts. A LEGENDARY relic is the opposite: it carries a 'hook', never a 'stats' block, states itself as one sentence with no number in it, and resolves inside CombatSimulation. ContentDatabase drops any entry that mixes the two, so the legendary grade's no-numbers rule is enforced at load rather than by review. 'mode' is Multiply for Attack/Defense/MaxHp/Speed (large scaled numbers - value 0.14 means x1.14) and Add for CritChance/CritDamage/EffectHit/EffectResist (small fractions that are never scaled by level or star rarity - value 0.12 means +0.12). The four relics that shipped before this rewrite (Splitting Prism, Warden's Debt, Stormlance Oath, Verdict Sigil) are cut, along with the three hooks only they used. Tidewrought Metronome and Green Hour Vessel stay cut, per DESIGN-HOOK-RESOLUTION sections 2 and 3: Tide owns the energy clamp and Verdant owns the heal clamp, so neither had any code left to run.
_valuesComment: All sixteen numbers below are first-pass and unbalanced by admission, not by oversight. They have not been through RunCampaignBalancePass. DESIGN-RELICS task 13's retune is the only pass that produces real values, and it has to run after this lands. Note that six of the eight move PowerScore, so a relicced team reaches a recommendedPower budget at a lower level than an unrelicced one.
